explanation: God's instructions and commandments given to the people of Israel to guide their lives and society.
An agreement between God and humans, often with promises and conditions from both parties.
The prophet and leader who led the people of Israel out of Egypt and received the law from God on Mount Sinai.
Idols or images made to represent deities, which are forbidden according to God's law.
The land and blessings that God promised to give the people of Israel as part of the covenant.
